answer: Locks are entered in oasis, expire in orchard, and shale lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 156 aliases therefore needs 71 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4421 identities would post 1588 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
